name: Thandol Span
summary: At Thandol Span, the surviving bridge lies under attack. Its stone arches link the Wetlands of Khaz Modan with the Arathi Highlands of southern Lordaeron, but Dark Iron infiltrators have sabotaged one crossing.

sections.title: The Fight for the Crossing
sections.body: Ironforge Mountaineers guard the surviving bridge. They fight to hold the roadway and drive back Dark Iron sappers, though the defense costs them dearly. If the bridge falls, northern trade and military movements will rely almost entirely on sea routes. Alliance forces in the Arathi Highlands will lose their immediate reinforcement.

sections.title: A Lifeline Severed
sections.body:
Dwarves built the Thandol Span after the War of the Three Hammers to link Ironforge with the Wildhammer clan at Aerie Peak. Its bridges rank among the grandest works of dwarven stonecraft, strong enough to bear entire marching armies. During the Second War, armies crossed between Lordaeron and Khaz Modan here, including Sir Anduin Lothar's counter-offensive south.

Now Dark Iron saboteurs have struck from nearby Dun Modr. Led by Balgaras the Foul and Kam Deepfury, they used explosives to shatter one span and threaten the overland route between the allied realms.

faq.answer: The Thandol Span carries you across a deep canyon between the Wetlands in northern Khaz Modan and the Arathi Highlands in southern Lordaeron. Dwarves built its two stone arches.

faq.q: Why is one of the bridges broken?
faq.answer: Dark Iron dwarves attacked from the captured outpost of Dun Modr. They used explosives to demolish one of the two spans and cut Alliance supply lines.

faq.q: Why was the Thandol Span originally built?
faq.answer: Ironforge dwarves built the Span after the War of the Three Hammers to strengthen trade, diplomacy, and ties with their Wildhammer cousins across the canyon in the north.

faq.q: Did armies cross here during the Second War?
faq.answer: Yes. The Old Horde crossed the sea to invade Lordaeron. Later, Sir Anduin Lothar led the Alliance counter-offensive across the Span, driving the orcs back into Khaz Modan.

angles.text: As a dwarf of Ironforge, you can take pride in the Span as a masterwork of your stonemasons. Yet it is a painful battleground where Dark Iron kin have brought destruction to your doorstep.
As an Alliance member, you depend on the Span as the only direct overland link between Khaz Modan and the beleaguered northern outposts of Lordaeron. Its defense is vital to the war effort.
